initial_condition_deltas.dvl_sequence_note: Sequence counters are process-local diagnostics; source time is the cross-run acquisition-phase contract.

position_delta.criterion: fresh-run GT start positions differ by <=0.02 m

velocity_delta.criterion: fresh-run GT start velocities differ by <=0.02 m/s

attitude_delta.criterion: fresh-run GT start attitudes differ by <=2 deg

dvl_source_time_delta.criterion: DVL source time at START differs by <=0.05 s

comparison.interpretation_rule: GT absolute pass + DVL absolute/equivalence fail isolates the estimator/feedback path. Similar GT and DVL physical failures are common-mode policy/guidance/action/actuator/plant evidence, not proof that DVL is causal.

mk2_artifact_exact_match.criterion: GT and DVL-EKF bags contain the identical verified artifact contract
